# Noto Sans KR

- Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanskr
- Original: NotoSansKR[wght].ttf, downloaded 2026-10-17 from the official Google Fonts repository.
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see OFL.txt alongside the font.
- Local asset: NotoSansKR-Variable.woff2, weight axis 100–900, normal style.
- Converted from the original with FontTools WOFF2 compression; no glyph subsetting or design changes.
- Served from the same origin; no runtime Google Fonts requests.
